content: Mbuur a kölàköl uboo a Imwol a du
Utaaŋ alan, alɔŋki bàsin tsütsü apà Ysɛu, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Abun, nà awà kölàköl uboo a Imwol a du? »
Yɛsu kàbel mwan mwɛy, kun'si uboboo a ba,
waa kàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa bɛ làsɔɔmà anki anà làkɔɔn abulà asànaa baan, bɛ làsàbilà anki kà Imwol a du.
Lalan, mbuur wanswà asàkal anà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n, nde asàkal wàkölàköl kà Imwol a du.
Mbuur awal mwan mwɛy asànaa wunà kà ikɔb amɛ, nde kan'wal mɛ ŋakwo. »
Igyɛɛŋ a ngwal
« Wɛɛ mbuur wanswà asiinà umwɛy uboo a bibaan ban'sà làkwikilà bà amu mɛ mubwà kà ube, yan'söön ubwaŋ akà nde naa bun'bäm nkɔŋ a kölàköl u bway, waa bun'tɔɔm kà indübà a an'dà.
Ngyɛb akà mɛɛn ntɔn ndaa yanswà ifàsyen baar mukyer ube! Ya ifàkɔɔn anki, wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur awà mbwo ayà ifàyà ndɛb!

Isàkal naa kɔɔ angye itàkal làkɔl angye làfasyen nkuur unsà ube, tsul la anà piy la ukwɛl. Ntɔn yan'söön ubwaŋ naa ngye abilà du a Nzam làkɔl làmwɛy itàkal kɔɔ làmwɛy, akwànaa ngye mukal amà an'kɔɔ an'mɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal in'kɔl myeel, waa batɔɔm u mbaa a mbul a in'tye.

Isàkal sye naa dii angye làfasyen nkuur unsà ube, kwool la, tɔɔm la ukwɛl. Ntɔn yan'söön ubwaŋ naa ngye abilà du a Nzam dii làmwɛy akwànaa ngye mukal amyà mii myeel, wɛɛ batɔɔm u mbaa a mbul a in'tye.
« Twon lan'bɛy akà umwɛy uboo a bibaan bi, ntɔn mɛ, mɛ in'tɛn a bɛ naa u du akyeey aba bàŋàmbar taaŋ lanswà kusà a Taaràmɛ awà u du.
[ Ntɔn Mwan a mbuur kàyi muyàtswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a baar bàdiimà mbwo. » ]
Un'kɔk kàdiimà anà kàfàmɛnà
« An'kyän abɛ mye aben? Isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy we amyà in'kɔk nkam, wɛɛ umwɛy udiimà, nkye nde usàwɛy anki in'kɔk an'kwem wà aŋiwà myumwɛy u mɔŋ ntɔn mukàleŋ un'kɔk mwɛy kàdiimà wà?
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa nde kan'man wa, nde ayàkal unsà un'sak aŋàsöönà ntɔn wa, akwànaa ntɔn an'kwem wà aŋiwà mpa myàdiimà.
Abun sye, Taaràbɛ awà u du akwen naa umwɛy uboo a bibaan bi ukɔɔn adiimà.
Ube a un'tɔŋ
« Isàkal naa un'tɔŋ angye kàmakyer ube, kyen kun'mɛn, kun'mɛɛy ube kan'kyer nde. Isàkal naa nde kan'kyey, ngye an'fuur itɔŋ abɛ.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa nde kawem anki, syen mbuur mwɛy itàkal baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l, ntɔn ndaa yanswà ikäl aŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n u mun a ambäl abɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär.
Isàkal naa nde ba kawem anki, kasaam ya kà Ikööŋ. Isàkal naa nde kan'tɔn muwem Ikööŋ, wɛy nde ukäl akà ngye asànaa mbuur mpa awà un'yudà itàkal un'füür a itɛr.
« Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: undiir wanswà làsàbäm bɛ u mɛɛn, wa asàkal wàŋàbäm u du. Undiir wanswà làsàtsuuŋ bɛ u mɛɛn, wa asàkal wàŋàtsuuŋ u du.
« Mɛ, mɛ in'fàlakyään naa isàkal naa baar abɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo abɛ ban'lwɛŋ u mɛɛn pà ntɔn mulɔm undiir, Taaràmɛ awà u du akyer asapà wa.
Ntɔn baar abɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär bàsàtüüb kà ikɔb amɛ, mɛ in'wà uboo a ba.»
Ndwääl a nkul
Apan, Petɔlà kàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu, waa kun'fuul naa: « Mwol, mbalà kwe mɛ an'kwo mudwääl un'tɔŋ amɛ nkul isàkal naa nde kàman'kyer ube? Nkye mbalà nsambwaar? »
Yɛsu naa: « Mɛ in'tɛn anki a ngye naa tii mbalà nsambwaar, wɛ, tii u mbalà an'kwem nsambwaar mbalà nsambwaar.
Abun, Imwol a du kyà asànaa mfum mwɛy kàkwen mulɔn ndaa a ngim ande anà asyääl ande.
U nsɛmà, ba bun'twääl umwɛy kàlun'fuur itɛr nsaab kwem.
Wɛɛ nde ngim afuur kàkäl ayà anki. Apan, nkum ande kàswɛŋ naa bayälà asànaa asɔ, nde anà un'kyay ande anà baan ande, anà indiir ande byanswà ntɔn mufur nkul ayin.
Apan, un'syääl awà kàbü an'köm kusà a nkum ande, waa kàtɛn naa: "Nkum, kaŋ mpem ntɔn mɛ, mɛ in'kyer ayàfur nkul angye yanswà."
Nkum ande kun'wem ngyɛb, waa kun'wɛy ungö akun'dwääl nkul ande.
Un'syääl awà kàtoo nde, nde kàbwey a umwɛy uboo a baar bàfàsal anà nde, awà kàlun'pà itɛr a ngim nkam mwɛy. Nde kun'si mpi a mpà anà mutɛn naa: "Fur nkul amɛ!"
Abun, mbuur awun kàbü an'köm, waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa: "Kaŋ mpem ntɔn mɛ, mɛ in'kyer ayafur!"
Wɛɛ un'syääl awun waa kàtön, kàkun'sà u bɔlokà tii mpal kàlàfur nde nkul ayin.
Mpal bàmɛn asyääl bumwɛy ndaa ayi, laa bàkyɛɛr ba, waa bàkàkyään nkum aba ndaa yanswà yàlyaŋ.
Apan, nkum kàbel un'syääl awun, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Un'syääl un'be! Nkul angye yanswà mɛ kàkyer apiy bwà, ntɔn ngye kàkyer an'bɔɔn.
Nkye ngye sye un'tɔŋ angye alun'wem anki ngyɛb asànaa kawem mɛ ngyɛb?"
Nkum ande kàwem nkyɛl, waa kun'pɛ akà aŋangwal tii mpal kàlàfur nde nkul ande yanswà.
« Taaràmɛ awà u du asàlakyer sye abun isàkal naa umwɛy umwɛy uboo a bɛ udwääl anki un'tɔŋ ande nkul a ibii ande unsà mpem ande wanswà. »
